title: Canonical Tenant Injection S1 FOUNDATION
cti_scope: S1 FOUNDATION only, prewrite readiness and stop-condition closeout

s1_items.required: EFS provisioning plus Lambda mount access point
s1_items.reason: AWS read-only inventory found no EFS file system, no EFS access point, no Lambda file system config, and no Lambda VPC config.

s1_items.required: Move 13 STORE_PATH values to durable EFS paths after verified snapshot and restore rehearsal
s1_items.reason: Lambda exposes zero required STORE_PATH env keys and no approved durable mount target exists.

s1_items.required: Create LAWOS_AUDIT_STORE_PATH and replace securityAuditEvents with durable append-only audit storage
s1_items.reason: Current code has no LAWOS_AUDIT_STORE_PATH manifest entry and keeps securityAuditEvents in memory.

s1_items.required: Wire fixed LAWOS_API_SESSION_SECRET from Secrets Manager or SSM with rotation runbook
s1_items.reason: Session signing secret exists in Secrets Manager, but Lambda has no LAWOS_API_SESSION_SECRET env and runtime code does not fetch Secrets Manager.

s1_items.required: Add reseed guard and approval_ref carve-out for later S4 merge backfill
s1_items.reason: Deferred until durable store and audit foundation are unblocked.

s1_items.required: Extend backup and restore drill to EFS stores with real-data-safe receipt schema
s1_items.reason: Current backup/restore drill is v0.1 synthetic-only and refuses non-synthetic backup claims.
